mentions.name: Scrolless
mentions.description: This Safari extension keeps the human parts of social media—search, DMs, stories, and posts from friends—while stripping out algorithmic feeds designed to capture attention.
mentions.problem: Algorithmic feeds on social media are designed to suck up users' attention.
mentions.audience: Social media users on Safari, especially those wanting to cut down on algorithmically driven feeds and reclaim their attention.
mentions.source_excerpt: Scrolless, a Safari extension that keeps all the human parts of social media (search, DMs, stories, posts from friends) while removing all the algorithmic garbage designed to suck up your attention.
mentions.author: jrflo
